disclaimers.general_disclaimer: This advisory is generated by PlantScan AI for preliminary screening and educational purposes. Always consult your local agricultural extension service (KVK) or certified agronomist before major farm management decisions.
disclaimers.chemical_safety_warning: DANGER / CAUTION: Synthetic chemicals and pesticides must be handled strictly according to manufacturer label instructions and local regulatory approvals. Always wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
disclaimers.organic_guidance_note: Organic and biological controls are recommended as first-line measures under Integrated Pest Management (IPM).
disclaimers.uncertainty_notice: When AI diagnostic confidence is below the threshold or visual features are ambiguous, avoid treating based on presumption.

status_messages.uncertain: Low diagnostic certainty. Follow the photo tips to retake a clear photo in natural light.
status_messages.unsupported_crop: The provided crop is outside the current diagnostic scope.

summaries.uncertain: Diagnostic confidence ({confidence}%) is below the threshold. Visual symptoms are ambiguous. Do not apply chemical pesticides without physical verification.
summaries.unsupported_crop: The provided crop '{crop}' is currently not in the PlantScan AI supported crop database.

photo_guidance: Ensure good natural daylight (avoid direct harsh midday sun or deep shadows).
Focus sharply on the lesion or affected area.
Include both top surface and underside of the leaf if possible.
Avoid taking photos with messy backgrounds, hands covering symptoms, or heavy motion blur.
prevention_measures: Isolate plants exhibiting symptoms to avoid cross-contamination.
Consult your local agricultural university or extension center (KVK).
Sanitize all pruning tools and equipment between field rows.
